name: Nico
intro: I'm a computer science student in Frankfurt am Main, Germany. I build self-hosted web apps, terminal tools and games — from a stock research dashboard running on a Raspberry Pi to a Spotify player written in Rust.

projects.title: Profit Pilot
projects.tagline: From a Java experiment to a Raspberry Pi deployment.
projects.description: A stock research dashboard with daily prices, technical indicators, company news and data exports. I run it on a Raspberry Pi 5, with Cloudflare Access and Tunnel handling access.
projects.detail: The work goes beyond charts: data imports, API budgets, deployment and recovery are part of the project too.
projects.stack: Java · Spring Boot · React · TypeScript · PostgreSQL

projects.title: Mini Player
projects.description: A compact Rust TUI for controlling Spotify playback and browsing playlists in the Kitty terminal. Includes keyboard controls and a PKCE login flow.

projects.title: Pokédex
projects.tagline: Explore the details. Build the team.
projects.description: A Pokémon explorer with search, filters, evolutions, stats and cries, backed by locally stored PokéAPI data.
projects.detail: In development: a team builder with AI-assisted VGC insights.
projects.stack: React · JavaScript · Express · SQLite · Tailwind CSS

projects.title: Asteroids
projects.tagline: My first C++ project. With a co-op mode.
projects.description: My take on the arcade classic, built with SFML: dodge asteroids, fight UFOs and chase persistent highscores. Play solo or together in co-op.
